curation: Positions are curated judgements written by research agents (rows of investigations_it20.tsv) and reviewed one by one. The code validates them (complete fields, closed vocabularies, contiguous ranks, existing need and unit, no dose, no absence claim, no conditional hypothesis called qualified) and computes no position. Ceiling rule: the published list carries at most ten rows; a row that carries a risk flag (direction state opposed_risk) or real human clinical reports is never placed below the line by displacement from a conditional probe, which goes below the line instead (whole ties are kept together); a row below the line stays in the table with its reason and is not judged unpromising.

three_axes.evidence_solidity: how much is already measured, in which system (field evidence_depth)
three_axes.priority_of_next_investigation: the value of the next discriminating experiment (position and the reason for it)
three_axes.development_feasibility: how realistic it is to take the intervention beyond a research probe (field feasibility)

wwox_contribution.note: Retrospective, limited to the measured properties: the number of generated proposals and their membership in matched random seed sets (real WWOX sets above the 95th percentile of degree- and reach-matched decoys in 0 of 5 sets). Not the general conclusion that WWOX adds no value: network interactions, cell-type-specific contrasts and role premises were not measured. No prospective benefit claim.

ceiling_rule: risk-flagged and human-report rows are not displaced by conditional probes

it22_changes.text: A decision about one molecule no longer blocks every molecule that shares its target: it travels only as far as its own reason (the molecule's own potency or label stays with it; a refuted premise still closes the arm it belongs to). 69 proposals were blocked by the old rule; 24 stay closed (premise refuted), 45 are released to be judged on their own data, none promoted.

Potency is compared only between measures of the same type; unlike measures are kept side by side and never turned into an exclusion. 20 proposals blocked on weak target attribution became 5 (the verifier's lower-bound rule restored one); the cautious case (a pan-HDAC inhibitor 2,769-fold weaker at the listed target, same measure type) stays blocked.

Observations that no generator input carried now reach it: a new question on NRF2 tone (one organoid contrast, adjusted p above the deposit's own alpha, role unknown) produced 20 new conditional proposals (the axis itself was already a carded thread since IT10; the compound routes are new); a failed control (the second neural system's progenitor arm did not show WWOX lower) is attached to 71 proposals and a contested direction to 75 more, as carried limits (recorded in the output; removing their ordering term changes no hand-over); a cell-type marker set can no longer become a gene seed; a premise or class limit now travels wherever its edge or target appears in a chain, not only inside one cluster.

What did not change: the number of generated proposals from the old inputs (980, only selection changed), the absence of any qualified hypothesis, and the earlier retrospective result (WWOX seed identity not separable from matched random sets on the measured properties only).

Seven of eight new hand-overs were qualified on their own data and end inconclusive or conditional. Seven of the 16 hand-overs rest on one organoid deposit and six flip direction if the unknown role of their question flips; the main limit is not the number of candidates but missing measurements in a WWOX-deficient neural system.

partial_benefit.why: Neuron-driven developmental myelin deficit with precursors up and mature cells down; maturation block favoured over loss but not demonstrated (IT14).
partial_benefit.candidate_class: Agonists of thyroid-hormone receptors (probe; a receptor-beta-leaning liver-directed agent only as isoform control)
partial_benefit.opposing: Thyroid-axis suppression and peripheral thyrotoxicosis at the effective mouse dose; seizure worsening reported in a few patients with prior seizures; premature differentiation.
partial_benefit.experiment: Seizure-free neuron plus precursor co-culture, WWOX-deficient versus corrected neurons, hormone-depleted medium, isoform control.
partial_benefit.closes_if: Correction in both genotypes (non-specific), or no change, or correction only with the receptor-beta-leaning control.
partial_benefit.novelty: New molecule for LEGEND in a known thread
partial_benefit.evidence: Conditional; human precedent is a hormone-entry defect without a neurodevelopmental endpoint
partial_benefit.feasibility: Cell probe now; systemic use limited

partial_benefit.why: Cytokine transcripts up in two mouse Wwox-deficient preparations (one significant in the null hippocampus).
partial_benefit.candidate_class: Blockers of the PRC2 methyltransferase EZH2, probe level; dual EZH1/EZH2 agents flagged highest-risk
partial_benefit.opposing: Net-negative on the myelin axis if both EZH1 and EZH2 are inhibited (oligodendrocyte differentiation blocked in mouse knockouts); cytokines rose after EZH2 suppression in tumour cells.
partial_benefit.experiment: Wwox-null versus wild-type glial cultures, the probe versus a second chemotype versus Ezh2 knockdown, histone mark and cytokine protein, with a parallel precursor-differentiation read.
partial_benefit.closes_if: Cytokines rise or precursor differentiation falls.
partial_benefit.novelty: Known thread re-emitted with a corrected counter-evidence and a new hazard
partial_benefit.evidence: Weak; sign contested; no measurement in a Wwox glia; brain exposure unmeasured
partial_benefit.wwox_relevance: Moderate for the observation, none for the lever

partial_benefit.why: Human knockout organoid shows a lower NFE2L2 transcript (0.75x), role unknown; the second system failed its control.
partial_benefit.candidate_class: A topical agent acting on the AhR pathway as an in vitro probe after step 0; direct NRF2-activating drugs remain the carded probes
partial_benefit.opposing: AhR-pathway activation is adverse in neural precursors in toxin studies; the pathway-target transcript is higher while NFE2L2 is lower.
partial_benefit.experiment: Step 0: nuclear NRF2, NQO1 activity and a ROS reporter in isogenic WWOX-deficient versus corrected neural cultures at baseline and after an oxidative challenge; then probe versus NFE2L2 knockdown.
partial_benefit.closes_if: No change at step 0 (axis not engaged), or AhR-dependent harm in precursors.
partial_benefit.novelty: New compound routes for the Q8 question; the NRF2 axis and its step 0 were already a carded thread since IT10; the molecule is in an earlier exclusion list
partial_benefit.evidence: Weak; edge supported outside neural cells; no CNS exposure data for the topical drug
partial_benefit.wwox_relevance: Low to moderate (one contrast, second system failed)
